subject: DataForge trial readiness & milestone roadmap
messages:
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: sam.carter@dataforge.ai, priya.shah@dataforge.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed trial milestones (DataForge)

Thanks again for the demo this morning — great conversation. As discussed, attaching a first-pass success criteria spreadsheet and a suggested milestone roadmap so we can align on what success looks like for a 6-week trial. High-level recap and next steps below: 

- Goals we heard: 1) Reduce inference latency on customer document search by ~40% under 500ms p95; 2) Bring down cost-per-query by ~30% vs current endpoint; 3) Validate data handling and audit logs for compliance.
- Proposed trial scope: 6 weeks, Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated pool (staging) for realistic throughput tests.
- Kickoff: week of Feb 22 (preferred) — technical onboarding, test corpus ingest, baseline benchmarks.
- Weekly cadence: 30-min check-ins on Mon mornings, with a written status update each Friday.
- Final readout: 1-hour review with metrics, cost analysis, and recommended next steps.

Action items (who/when):
- DataForge: share sample dataset (anonymized) and one SLA-style query set by Tue 2/16 — Priya.
- Redwood: provide access checklist, initial infra template, and trial runbook by Thu 2/18 — Grace/Marissa.
- Mutual: confirm kickoff date by EOD Fri 2/19.

Attachments: DF-POC-success-criteria-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet with metrics & acceptance gates), trial-kickoff-agenda.pdf

Thanks — I'll follow up with calendar invites once we lock the kickoff.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

----

From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@dataforge.ai>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: priya.shah@dataforge.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed trial milestones (DataForge)

Thanks Grace — this is exactly what we needed to move forward. A couple clarifications on the success criteria spreadsheet: 

1) For latency, can we include both p95 and p99 targets? Our production SLAs are p99-oriented.
2) On cost targets, instead of a percent reduction we need an absolute target range (USD/query) for comparisons.

Priya will send the anonymized dataset by EOD Tue 2/16. For kickoff, Feb 23 morning (PST) works for our infra lead — can Redwood confirm availability?

Also, small ask: can Redwood stand up a temporary dedicated pool with tokenized logs disabled (we will provide a separate audit agent) — we need to validate your routing and autoscaling behavior without shipping full logs offsite.

Sam
CTO, DataForge
sam.carter@dataforge.ai

----

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo recap + proposed trial milestones (DataForge)

Looping in infra (Aditya) and solutions to check feasibility for the request below about tokenized logs. Draft replies:

- We can provide p99 and p95 latency lines in the success criteria doc; update spreadsheet accordingly.
- Cost: we'll add absolute cost per query projections by model and batch size.
- Tokenized logs: we can offer a configuration where token-level logging is disabled and we surface audit events via the customer's audit agent + structured audit report export. Need confirmation from infra on timeline to stand up dedicated pool for Feb 23.

I'll build the kickoff calendar invite template and assign owners.

Marissa
VP, Solutions
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: sam.carter@dataforge.ai, priya.shah@dataforge.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed trial milestones (DataForge)

Confirmed — infra can provision a small Dedicated pool in our staging region and disable tokenized telemetry for that customer slice. Estimated time to provision and sanity checks: 24–36 hours. We will:

- Create tenant-scoped dedicated pool (staging-us-west-2) with the same kernel selection but reduced replica count for cost control.
- Disable tokenized logs; enable audit event export to S3 (owner: DataForge audit agent).
- Pre-load KV cache with the provided sample corpus for baseline runs.

Grace/Marissa: I uploaded a provisioning checklist and a runbook excerpt here: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-materials (see file 'provisioning-checklist.md'). Plan to finalize early Wed and send invites for Feb 23 kickoff (09:00 PST).

- Aditya (Infra)

----

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: sam.carter@dataforge.ai, priya.shah@dataforge.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed trial milestones (DataForge)

Appreciate the quick responses — Feb 23 at 09:00 PST is locked. Calendar invite sent. Updated attachments include: DF-POC-success-criteria-v1.xlsx (now includes p95/p99 rows and absolute USD/query estimates) and trial-kickoff-agenda.pdf (includes owners and prep checklist).

Quick checklist for kickoff (owners):
- DataForge: share anonymized dataset + SLA query set — Priya (by 2/16) [received].
- Redwood Infra: provisioning complete and logs disabled — Aditya (done).
- Redwood Solutions: runbook and test corpus ingest steps — Marissa (deliver by 2/18).

See you next week — we'll run baseline tests in days 1–3 and start throughput tuning in week 2. Final readout tentatively scheduled for Mar 5 (1 hr) to present metrics and recommendation.

Best,
Grace
